title: Planning with Transformers: Chain of Computation and Structured Context Windows
abstract: arXiv:2607.17710v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have had a remarkable impact across many areas of machine learning. However, recent studies have shown that they struggle to reliably solve planning problems, particularly when compared with classical planners. Even with recent advances in reasoning-oriented models, the extent to which LLMs can genuinely perform planning remains an open question. At the same time, theoretical results have shown that transformers, the core architecture underlying modern LLMs, are Turing-complete. In this work, we investigate this apparent gap between the theoretical computational power of LLMs and their empirical planning performance. We propose Chain of Computation (COC), a computational architecture that places a transformer-based LM inside an iterative loop and leverages its strength as a pattern-matching system. translated_title: 基于Transformer的规划：计算链与结构化上下文窗口
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）已在机器学习的许多领域产生了显著影响。然而，近期研究表明，它们难以可靠地解决规划问题，尤其是与经典规划器相比时。即使推理导向模型最近取得了进展，LLMs能否真正执行规划仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。与此同时，理论结果表明，作为现代LLMs核心架构的transformer是图灵完备的。在这项工作中，我们研究了LLMs的理论计算能力与其实证规划性能之间这一明显的差距。我们提出了计算链（COC），这是一种计算架构，它将基于transformer的语言模型置于迭代循环中，并利用其作为模式匹配系统的优势。COC使用结构化上下文窗口（SCW）作为外部存储器，使模型只能访问其中的部分内容。
tldr: 提出计算链（COC）计算架构，通过将基于Transformer的语言模型置于迭代循环中并利用结构化上下文窗口作为外部记忆，以弥合LLMs理论计算能力与实际规划性能之间的差距。
en_tdlr: Proposes Chain of Computation (COC), a computational architecture that places a transformer-based LM inside an iterative loop with a Structured Context Window as external memory, aiming to bridge the gap between LLMs' theoretical computational power and their empirical planning performance.
